result.description: AGROVISE  Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated and experienced Agricultural and Agritech Technician to join our team. The successful applicant will support the installation, commissioning, operation, testing, maintenance and optimisation of agricultural technology systems and equipment, while assisting with irrigation management, precision agriculture, crop production technologies, field trials, technical data collection and the delivery of innovative agritech solutions across a range of agricultural projects in Western Australia.   Benefits   Competitive salary package of $80,000 – $100,000 plus superannuation.   Ongoing training and professional development in agricultural technology, irrigation and automation systems.   Opportunity to work with innovative agricultural, water and renewable energy projects across Western Australia.    Task & responsibilities   Examine topographical, physical and soil characteristics of farmland to assist in determining optimal land use and identifying nutrient deficiencies.   Assist Agricultural Research Scientists and Agronomists in developing improved methods of planting, fertilising, irrigation, harvesting and crop management to maximise productivity.   Identify plant diseases, pests, fungi and weeds affecting agricultural production and assist in implementing appropriate control measures.   Provide technical advice, training and support to clients on agricultural technology solutions, including sensors, remote monitoring systems, farm management software and automation technologies.   Install, configure, program, test, commission, repair and maintain advanced agricultural technology and equipment, including irrigation controllers, pumping systems, sensors, telemetry, automation and precision agriculture systems.   Develop, operate and maintain integrated agricultural technology systems used in irrigation, water management and farm production, including analysing operational data and preparing technical reports.   Conduct field testing, equipment inspections, fault diagnosis and preventative maintenance to ensure efficient operation of agricultural infrastructure and agritech equipment.   Collect, record and analyse technical and operational data to evaluate system performance and recommend improvements.   Prepare technical documentation, maintenance records, installation reports and service schedules.   Work collaboratively with engineers, project managers and clients to deliver innovative agricultural infrastructure and technology solutions while ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety requirements.    Qualification & experience   Certificate IV, Diploma or higher qualification in Agricultural Technology, Agricultural Engineering,  or a closely related discipline.   At least one year of relevant industry experience (more experienced applicants are encouraged to apply).   Experience working with irrigation systems, pumps, agricultural equipment or automated control systems.    About Company    Agrovise is a Western Australian engineering and agritech company specialising in greenhouse infrastructure, protected cropping and agricultural technology solutions. The company designs, installs and maintains greenhouse systems, irrigation and fertigation infrastructure, climate control and automation systems, helping commercial growers improve productivity, water efficiency and sustainable farming practices across Western Australia. result.description:
Lead electrical mining projects from concept to commissioning while enjoying a 5:2 roster   Your new company  
 Our client is a leading Australian resources organisation with a strong commitment to operational excellence, safety, and sustainable project delivery. With a substantial portfolio of capital projects and ongoing investment in site infrastructure, they offer the opportunity to work on complex projects within a collaborative and high-performing team environment. 
   Your new role  
 As an Electrical Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing electrical capital projects through the full project life cycle, from early studies and detailed design through to construction, commissioning, and handover. You will work closely with consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders to deliver projects safely, on schedule, and within budget. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Managing electrical projects from concept development through to completion 
 Coordinating consultants during feasibility studies, engineering, and detailed design phases 
 Managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and reporting requirements 
 Overseeing contractors and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations 
 Leading project execution, construction activities, and commissioning works 
 Reviewing and managing project documentation, technical deliverables, and governance requirements 
 Collaborating with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external stakeholders 
 Ensuring all work is delivered in line with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements 
 Driving project performance and continuous improvement outcomes 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated experience managing electrical projects within mining, resources, heavy industry, energy, or infrastructure environments 
 Proven experience managing consultants through study, design, and project delivery phases 
 Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies and project governance requirements 
 Experience managing contractors during construction and commissioning activities 
 Sound knowledge of contract administration and contractor management 
 Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and leadership skills 
 Ability to manage multiple project priorities in a dynamic operational environment 
 Electrical trade or engineering qualifications will be highly regarded. 
 Commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards 
 
   What you'll get in return  
 This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly regarded mining operation and contribute to the successful delivery of critical electrical infrastructure projects. You'll work on a Monday-to-Thursday site roster with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays, while camp accommodation is provided throughout your assignment. Both FIFO and DIDO options are available, offering flexibility for candidates across Queensland. You'll join a supportive team environment where your expertise will directly influence the success of key site projects and future growth initiatives. 
   What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please call Jennah Murray 07 4960 1129. 
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $110,000 - $130,000 p.a plus Super
Employer Name: J & DE HOMES PTY LTD - T/a JDE HOMES
A.B.N. 24 614 743 789
Job Location: Level 2, 207 Pulteney Street, Adelaide, SA, 5000,  AUSTRALIA
Advertising Period: 28 days - 13 Jul 2026 > 10 Aug 2026

Please include Reference: J1697-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Summary

Our client JDE Homes is seeking to add a Construction Project Manager to its South Australian construction and development team. The company delivers fixed-price property construction, development and project management services across residential, civil, industrial and commercial projects. This role will support the planning, coordination and delivery of technically challenging building projects, while maintaining quality, budget, safety and completion requirements.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Plan, organise and manage construction projects from commencement through to practical completion.
- Coordinate project resources, including labour, subcontractors, materials, plant and equipment.
- Interpret architectural drawings, construction plans, engineering details and technical specifications.
- Monitor project budgets, timelines, quality standards, risks and contractual obligations.
- Liaise with architects, engineers, consultants, clients, subcontractors and relevant authorities.
- Manage procurement scheduling and ensure materials are available to meet construction milestones.
- Supervise site progress and ensure works align with approved plans and specifications.
- Coordinate inspections, approvals and documentation required by councils and regulatory bodies.
- Ensure adherence to workplace health, safety, building and performance standards.
- Negotiate with suppliers, subcontractors and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
- Prepare project reports, progress updates, cost reviews and construction documentation.
- Manage project variations, delays, defects and implementation of corrective actions.
- Lead subcontractors and site teams to achieve quality and programme outcomes.
- Support tender preparation, contract administration and construction methodology recommendations.
- Maintain professional communication with clients to support cost-effective project delivery.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Minimum ten years of relevant experience in construction project management or building project delivery.
- Strong ability to manage residential, commercial, civil or industrial construction projects from start to finish.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating subcontractors, trades, consultants, suppliers, plant, equipment and site resources.
- Sound knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, building processes, safety obligations and quality standards.
- Proven ability to monitor project costs, budgets, schedules, risks, variations and completion deadlines.
- Strong communication skills for liaising with clients, architects, engineers, authorities and internal project teams.
- Practical experience resolving construction issues and recommending cost-effective building methods or project solutions.
- Ability to work without direct supervision while maintaining accurate project records and professional standards.

Please include Reference: J1697-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

result.description:
IT Systems & Support Technician (Industrial Automation)

About our client 

Kogan People Solutions has been retained by a leading automotive components manufacturer to recruit a highly focused tech professional for their automated production facility. Our client operates a state of  the art, continuous manufacturing environment where 100% of finished products undergo sophisticated, computer controlled validation before release. Due to operational expansion and the critical nature of their systems, we are seeking a dedicated IT Systems Support Technician to ensure their core industrial computing infrastructure remains online and optimized.

Role Overview
This is a highly specialized, business-critical role embedded directly within an advanced manufacturing environment. You will be responsible for the continuous, real-time monitoring of two advanced Turbo Test Duo balancing and calibration systems driven by embedded software platforms.

To confirm: This is not a mechanical repair position. The primary objective is the maintenance, troubleshooting, and support of the highly integrated computer systems, hardware interfaces, and proprietary software that governs the physical machinery.

Location: Cheltenham, VIC

Job Type: Full-time, Ongoing 

Salary $80,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation  per annum.

Responsibilities 
•	Actively oversee and analyze the operation of embedded, computer-controlled industrial systems throughout the day.

•	Instantly respond to automated software alerts and digital system alarms to isolate faults across integrated computer hardware and data logging modules.

•	Resolve complex technical issues occurring within specialized proprietary software configurations and peripheral IT components.

•	Manage, verify, and update software profiles, system parameters, and computer calibration data to guarantee operational accuracy.

•	Maintain precise digital records of system errors, technical configurations, and software performance logs to feed into predictive risk management.

Required Skills, Qualifications & Experience

•	Diploma, or higher qualification in a highly related IT discipline or agreed substitute

•	Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of professional experience supporting integrated computer networks, automated software platforms, or industrial IT hardware interfaces.

•	Proven experience interpreting real-time software diagnostics, system logs, and bi-directional hardware/software integration.

•	Strong ability to diagnose computing faults rapidly under pressure to minimize production downtime. 

•	Excellent communication skills to interface with production engineers.

•	Ability to prioritise, multitask and work independently.

•	A passion for learning and staying ahead of technology trends.

•	Ability to analyse and evaluate complex IT issues.

•	High attention to detail and documentation accuracy

You will have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to be considered. 

How to Apply

If you possess the specialized IT skills required to support critical, automated industrial computing infrastructure, Kogan People Solutions wants to hear from you. Accompanying your application, we would prefer to see a cover letter detailing your specific software and hardware troubleshooting experience

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Sales Representative (Industrial Products) (Full-Time) – Ausgreen Solar Solutions, NSW & ACT

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting efficient and sustainable energy systems.

We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Sales Representative (Industrial Products) to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a technically minded sales professional who enjoys developing business relationships, promoting industrial products, providing product solutions, and achieving sales objectives within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
• Location: NSW 2200 & ACT 2601
• Full-time, ongoing position
• Work within a growing renewable energy and industrial products business
• Opportunity to develop expertise in solar and energy efficiency solutions
• Career development opportunities within a growing industry

Key Responsibilities
• Promote and sell industrial renewable energy products, including solar panels, inverters, batteries, and related energy solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Identify potential customers and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, customer enquiries, and sales activities.
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective commercial clients, contractors, and industry stakeholders.
• Assess customer requirements and provide technical product information and suitable solutions based on customer needs.
• Prepare quotations, sales proposals, product specifications, and technical information for customers.
• Negotiate sales agreements, pricing, and product requirements with customers and suppliers.
• Manage customer accounts and maintain regular communication to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction and repeat business opportunities.
• Provide advice regarding product features, benefits, installation requirements, and energy solutions.
• Liaise with internal technical and installation teams to coordinate product delivery and ensure customer requirements are met.
• Monitor market conditions, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer demand to identify new sales opportunities.
• Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and business opportunities.
• Prepare sales reports and provide updates on market opportunities, customer feedback, and sales performance.
• Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and industry standards.

What We're Looking For
• Relevant qualification in sales, business, marketing, engineering, renewable energy, or a related field OR 
• Minimum five year of relevant experience in industrial product sales, technical sales, or business-to-business sales.
• Experience selling technical products or solutions to commercial and industrial customers.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer relationship management, and business development.
• Ability to interpret customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
• Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer accounts and sales activities.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and achieve sales targets.
• Willingness to develop knowledge of solar energy products, renewable technologies, and industrial applications.

How to Apply
11 Recruitment is assisting Ausgreen Solar Solutions with the recruitment process. If you are a dedicated sales professional with experience in industrial products and a passion for renewable energy solutions, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your sales career.

About the company

Zimmermann Industries is a leading Australian signage, branding and corporate identity specialist, established in 2007. The company delivers end-to-end solutions, managing every stage from concept and design through to fabrication, installation and maintenance. With strong foundations in traditional signwriting and advanced expertise in custom architectural, electronic and retail signage, Zimmermann Industries helps businesses maximise brand visibility and create lasting impressions. Known for innovation, quality craftsmanship and reliable service, the company has successfully delivered outstanding projects across diverse industries.

About the role

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Representative to promote and grow our industrial signage, branding, and fabrication solutions. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, building strong client relationships, preparing quotations, conducting product presentations, and achieving sales targets. You will work closely with customers to understand their requirements and provide tailored solutions. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication and negotiation skills, a proactive approach to business development, and a passion for delivering outstanding customer service while driving revenue growth and market expansion.

About the position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of Work: 9 Trade Place, Lilydale, Vic -3140

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus guaranteed superannuation

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Technical Assessment & Client Consultation: Review client concepts and architectural plans to assess technical needs, recommending the most suitable industrial fabrication methods, materials, and services to achieve the desired outcome. 
•	Commercial Quoting & Estimating: Scope out the true technical costs of manufacturing bespoke products on the factory floor. Prepare, quote, and negotiate accurate pricing for high-end retail and commercial signage projects. 
•	Technical Translation: Act as the technical liaison for the sales team, updating knowledge of our manufacturing capabilities, materials, and competitors' offerings to ensure our quoted solutions are highly marketable and viable. 
•	Production & Logistics Coordination: Factor in the complete lifecycle of the product during the estimating phase, arranging and quoting the delivery of goods, site logistics, and the provision of installation services. 
•	Reporting & Workflow Integration: Prepare detailed estimating reports for operations and sales management to ensure accurate project handovers. Follow up with the production team and clients to ensure satisfaction and resolve any technical problems arising during the build. 
Qualification and Skills
•	Bachelor of Industrial Design (Honors) or a higher degree in a highly relevant technical discipline (e.g., Engineering, Industrial Design). 
•	A Minimum of 1 year of relevant professional B2B experience in sales of industrial design, retail store design, or technical fabrication. 
•	Technical Proficiency: High-level understanding of industrial manufacturing processes, CAD, and how complex concepts are physically built on a factory floor. 
•	Commercial Acumen: Strong foundation skills in product costing, with a willingness to be mentored in the commercial, quoting, and negotiating aspects of the business. 

Interested in the role? Apply for the role if you think you meet the criteria, and we’ll get in contact with you shortly. Only eligible candidates will be contacted.

Heavy Diesel Plant Mechanic | Boilermaker

Force Equipment, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Emeco Group, is seeking suitably experienced and qualified trades personnel to join our workshop teams. These teams are focused on the inspection, overhaul, rebuild, and repair of heavy mobile equipment components, supporting high-quality, reliable outcomes for our mining customers through industry-leading workshop facilities and systems.

Reporting to the Workshop Supervisor, you will be responsible for maintaining Force (and customer) equipment / machines ensuring availability / integrity, successful candidates will be responsible for: 

•	Focus on safe working environment and quality of workmanship. 
•	Major customer machine rebuilds carried out in the workshop
•	Ongoing repairs and maintenance of in-house and customer equipment
o	Maintenance and repairs on Caterpillar, Liebherr, Elphinstone, Sandvik, Atlas Copco - Epiroc, Hitachi and Komatsu mobile equipment    within budgets and time frames
o	Working with the Force Equipment customers to meet their company objectives; and
o	Quality control on all work performed. 

Your Skills and Experience:
•	Nationally recognised trade qualification
•	Experience with heavy earthmoving equipment
•	A strong commitment to safety
•	Good analytical and problem-solving skills with a solution focus
•	A keen eye for detail, presentation and craftsmanship; and
•	The ability to work as part of a cohesive team

We Offer 
•	Opportunity to grow and develop through training and future career opportunities
•	Competitive hourly rates
•	Variety of work; and
•	Permanent employment

About you
•	Australian recognised trade certificate
•	Demonstrated experience in servicing, repair and component change outs across a variety of mobile earthmoving equipment.

How to apply
Contact Nat on 0497 348 512 or natalie.marley@emecogroup.com for more info or click on 'Apply' and upload your CV today!
Emeco Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer - we encourage applicants who identify as Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander to apply.

To learn more about Force job opportunities: https://forceequipment.com.au/careers

Force is a member of the Emeco Group. Emeco was founded in 1972 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX: EHL). We have operations in all key mining regions of Australia and our customers include mining companies and contractors across coal, gold, copper, bauxite and iron ore.
